title: 美银Maddie Jow：下调布油预测至70美元，明年供应过剩但需求结构性受损
speaker: Maddie Jow

segments.en: I know you guys just lowered your forecast for Brent just a few days ago. But so, tell us a little bit more about how quickly do you think flows can actually normalize in the straight-up?
segments.zh: 我知道你们几天前下调了布伦特原油预测。那么你认为供应流能多快恢复正常？

segments.en: Yeah. So, yes, we lower our Brent oil forecast to about $70 for second half and also next year as well. We are still expecting a small deficit for the Q3 because of still takes time for the flow to normalize and then also for the volume to arrive in Asia as well.
segments.zh: 是的，我们将布伦特原油下半年和明年的预测下调至约70美元。我们仍预计三季度出现小幅短缺，因为供应流正常化和原油运抵亚洲需要时间。

segments.en: However, into next year we believe it will turn into surplus again, want this flow come in. One of the key reason, of course, the demand is quite weak as well.
segments.zh: 然而，到明年，随着供应流入，我们认为将再次转为过剩。关键原因之一是需求相当疲弱。

segments.en: If you look at last month's China data, actually input was down 30 percent on oil perspective. Some of them is because of using strategic reference or commercial reserve. But I think also we are expecting that the demand was probably down around 10 percent of the real demands just on that one month's perspective.
segments.zh: 看上月中国数据，原油进口下降了30%。部分原因是动用战略储备或商业库存。但我们也认为，仅就一个月而言，实际需求可能下降了约10%。

segments.en: Some demand may be able to come back, like for example, some chemical demands. But some demand was actually permanently replaced by using more electric truck or EVs and also turning to co-chemical, etc. So, you're saying some of it is structural. Yeah.
segments.zh: 部分需求可能恢复，例如化工需求。但一些需求已被电动卡车、电动汽车以及转向煤化工等永久替代。所以你说部分是结构性的。是的。

segments.en: I think next year, yes. That's what we are expecting next year. It will be a surplus. However, for the rest of this year, I think market don't need to panic that much first because at the end of the day, we have already run down inventory for more than three months, right?
segments.zh: 我认为明年是的，我们预计明年将出现过剩。但今年剩余时间，市场不必过于恐慌，因为我们已经消耗库存超过三个月了。
